run_multiprocessing_bpe_encode: run the multiprocessing BPE encoder script to encode raw text files using GPT-2 BPE tokenization
encode_lines_with_bpe: encode lines of raw text into GPT-2 BPE token IDs using the MultiprocessingEncoder class
decode_bpe_tokens: decode BPE token IDs back into raw text using the MultiprocessingEncoder decode method
encode_single_line: encode a single line of text into BPE token IDs using the MultiprocessingEncoder encode method
decode_lines_from_tokens: decode multiple lines of BPE token IDs back into raw text using the MultiprocessingEncoder decode_lines method
